quote: Code generation, which aims to automatically produce source code from natural language descriptions

We focus on function-level code generation tasks... The generated code is considered a "pass" if it successfully passes the entire test suite, meaning it produces the correct output for all test cases.

Code generation, which aims to automatically produce source code from natural language descriptions, has attracted significant attention from both academia and industry due to its potential to streamline software development.

We evaluate code generation accuracy by calculating the pass rate across all tasks in the dataset. An LLM is considered to pass a coding task if the code it generates successfully passes all test cases for that task.
